title: Staff measurement switches of the chain build, and the first failures of each rule on the bench-run door
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: With planTurns on in chainTrials, the plan step starts its planner run with --plan-turns and records the switch; off or unset, the run starts with the same arguments as before.
The settings keep only known switches that are on and refuse an unknown name or a value that is not a boolean.
A bench round keeps the first three failures of each rule, with quoted words, long numbers and addresses masked, and no reason for a picture round.

tests: with planTurns on, the plan step plans round 0 in turns and records the switch; off, it starts as before
the settings keep only known switches that are on, and the door refuses an unknown name or a value that is not a boolean
a round keeps the first three failures of each rule, with the business's words, numbers and addresses masked
a picture round also says where its own time went (its manifest's timing), as numbers only
